title: Run a command as another user using pkexec
summary: Use pkexec with the --user option to run a command as a specific user other than root. This is useful for running tasks as a different account.

steps.explain: Run the specified command as the given user. You may be prompted for authentication.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The username to run the command as

rollback.explain: There is no direct undo for a command run as another user. Manually revert any changes if necessary.

warnings: Ensure you have permission to run commands as the specified user.
